content: Graph view UX: global graph is good at 50-200 nodes and becomes an unreadable hairball past a few hundred to 1000+; usefulness is entirely a function of filtering by tag, folder, link depth. Local graph (current node within N hops) is the genuinely useful navigation affordance. Consensus: treat graph view as a cleanup/diagnostic tool for orphans, dense clusters and missing links rather than the primary browse surface.
